clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Opens Muhammadiyah Anniversary In Palu
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto presided over the 114th anniversary and Tanwir event of the Muhammadiyah organization in Palu.
The event featured discussions regarding the criteria for a future vice president and concerns regarding economic and political oligarchy.

clusters.headline: Political And Economic Repercussions Following Gibran Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially resigned from his position as Vice President of Indonesia on November 12, 2026.
Government officials and economic analysts stated that the resignation is not expected to disrupt national economic targets or investment.

clusters.headline: President Subianto To Finalize Vice President Selection Post-Travel
aiSummaryBullets: President Subianto announced plans to select a new Vice President upon returning from state visits to Manila and Shenzhen.
Coalition parties have been requested to submit candidate names, with some groups proposing potential nominees while others defer to the President.

clusters.headline: Indonesia U17 National Team Secures Victory Against Cambodia
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesia U17 football team defeated Cambodia 2-0 during a Group A match in the 2027 AFC U17 Asian Cup qualification round.
This outcome marks the second straight win for the Indonesian squad within the qualifying competition.

clusters.headline: Polda NTT Investigates Alleged Sexual Assault By Kupang Regent
aiSummaryBullets: Regional police are investigating allegations of sexual assault involving the Regent of Kupang, Yosef Lede.
The incident is reported to have occurred at the official residence of the regent and involves a 21-year-old complainant.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Commends New Police Chief Suyudi Ario
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto publicly commended General Suyudi Ario Seto during the 114th Muhammadiyah Tanwir event.
Prabowo described the new police chief as an inspiring and calming figure for the country.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Confers Honors On Forest Fire Response Personnel
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto awarded Bintang Jasa honors to 23 volunteers and health workers injured or killed during forest fire missions.
The government has committed to ensuring the welfare and future of the families affected by the incidents.

clusters.headline: Pertamina Explores Fast Charging Infrastructure With BYD Alliance
aiSummaryBullets: Pertamina Patra Niaga signed a strategic collaboration agreement with BYD Motor Indonesia.
The initiative focuses on assessing the integration of BYD flash charging technology into Green Energy Stations.

clusters.headline: SKK Migas And MedcoEnergi Collaborate On National Energy Security
aiSummaryBullets: SKK Migas and MedcoEnergi are intensifying efforts to increase energy production.
Strategic projects are being accelerated to bolster national energy independence.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Prepares For Upcoming Guns N' Roses And BTS Performances
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung expects major international concerts to bolster local tourism and economic activity.
City authorities will extend operating hours for public transportation, including MRT, LRT, and TransJakarta, to accommodate concert attendees.
